items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I met Janice, I believe, at the Cafe Society... And she and I got married in 1944, I believe we got married, or 1945.

ctx.x: Where did you meet her, Teddy?
I met Janice, I believe, at the Cafe Society when I was playing there. The Cafe Society downtown
in New York, during the second World War. And she and I got married in 1944, I believe we got married, or 1945. I met her in 1944, I think we got married in 1945, and then my oldest son, Theodore --
